'''Chelsey Grimes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Grimes lived in the city of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He worked as the manager of the [[Space Monkey Café]]. He was assisted in his duties by the [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Adran Blake]] and he sometimes worked on the café's bar.<ref name="Find the Lady" />
